description: The character of a Town, judged from its deterministic Essence and census summary. Sealed battery (ADR-0018): the text is byte-stable; rewording means a new version, never an edit.

tall_for_a_town.instructions: Judge the claim: the buildings here are tall for a town.

criteria.true: The recorded building heights are high for an ordinary town: mid-rise blocks or taller are typical.
criteria.false: The recorded heights are modest for a town, or too few heights are recorded to call the Town tall.

steep_roofs.instructions: Judge the claim: roofs here pitch steeply rather than lying flat.

criteria.true: Gable and hip shapes dominate the recorded roof mix.
criteria.false: Flat roofs dominate the recorded mix, the mix leans flat, or too few roof shapes are recorded to say.

uniform_roofs.instructions: Judge the claim: one roof shape covers almost every building here.

criteria.true: A single roof shape holds nearly all of the recorded weight.
criteria.false: The recorded roof mix is genuinely mixed, or too few roof shapes are recorded to say.

dense_not_spread.instructions: Judge the claim: the place feels dense rather than spread out.

criteria.true: The recorded counts suggest many buildings packed into one Town: a compact, built-up place.
criteria.false: The counts suggest few buildings for a whole Town, or the counts are too small to say.

warm_earthy_walls.instructions: Judge the claim: the common wall colours here are warm and earthy rather than cool and grey.

criteria.true: The recorded palette leans warm: browns, creams, ochres, terracottas, wood tones.
criteria.false: The recorded palette leans cool, grey or dark, or too few colours are recorded to say.

mostly_conifers.instructions: Judge the claim: the trees here are mostly conifers.

criteria.true: Conifers such as hemlock, spruce and cedar hold most of the recorded tree species mix.
criteria.false: Broadleaves dominate the recorded mix, conifers are a small share of it, or no tree species are recorded.

rainy_coast.instructions: Judge the claim: this is a rainy coastal place.

criteria.true: The summary places the Town in a coastal rainforest climate.
criteria.false: The summary places the Town in a temperate climate, or records no climate for it.

heights_recorded.instructions: Judge the claim: most buildings here have a recorded height.

criteria.true: A high share of the Town's buildings carries a recorded height.
criteria.false: Only a small share of the buildings has a recorded height.

height_scale.instructions: How tall is the Town's building stock, on this scale?
criteria: Almost nothing rises above a single storey; the place reads as huts and sheds.
Nearly all buildings are single-storey.
Single-storey buildings dominate, with a scattering of two-storey ones.
Two-storey buildings are typical, and single-storey ones remain common.
A town of two- and three-storey buildings.
Three- to four-storey buildings line the streets.
Mid-rise blocks of five to eight storeys are common.
Mid-rise and high-rise mix: many buildings reach nine to fourteen storeys.
High-rise: towers of fifteen storeys and more rise over mid-rise blocks.
A vertical core: towers dominate the skyline.

known_in_detail.instructions: How completely is this place recorded: building heights, roof shapes, wall colours, captures?
criteria: Almost nothing is recorded: heights, roofs and colours are unknown for nearly every building.
Sparse recording: a small share of buildings has a known height or roof shape.
Partial recording: many buildings have heights, fewer have roof shapes or colours.
Good recording: most buildings have known heights and roof shapes.
Thorough recording: nearly every building's height, roof and colour are known, and captures exist.

green_setting.instructions: How green is the Town's setting, from paved ground to deep forest?
criteria: Paved and built: hardly a tree appears in the summary.
A built place with street trees and gardens.
A green town: trees are about as common as buildings.
Wooded: trees clearly outnumber the buildings.
Deep forest: the summary is mostly trees, and buildings read as a clearing in them.
